omnichannelContextField.name: Continuous Context Fidelity Tensor & Information Decay Field
omnichannelContextField.stateSpace: F(t) in [0, 1]^K with K = 6 canonical context sub-fields (identity_binding, auth_assurance, intent_embedding, slot_ledger, provenance_digest, consent_vector)

equations.componentFidelityDecay: f_k(t) = f_k(t_0) * exp(-lambda_k * delta_t) * (1 - eta_mod(c_prev, c_curr)) * (1 - eta_carrier)
equations.mutualInformationRetention: I_norm(t) = I(X_origin; X_hat_active(t)) / H(X_origin) = sum_k w_k * f_k(t)
equations.shannonContextEntropy: H(C_t) = -sum_{k=1}^K (p_k * ln(p_k) + (1 - p_k) * ln(1 - p_k)) / K

a2aContinuousField.name: Continuous A2A Capability Manifold, Boltzmann Routing Kernel & Spectral Loop Energy
a2aContinuousField.stateSpace: Each agent a in A embeds at u_a in R^16 with authority radius rho_a in [0, 1], latency hazard tau_a in [0, 1], and instantaneous load l_a(t) in [0, 1]

equations.authorityFeasibilityGate: g_auth(z_t, a) = sigmoid(kappa * (rho_a - max(z_t[compliance_exposure], z_t[billing_exposure], z_t[fraud_risk_density])))
equations.boltzmannRoutingKernel: P(a | z_t) = exp(beta * (sim(z_t, u_a) * g_auth(z_t, a) - gamma * l_a(t) - eta * tau_a)) / Z(z_t)
equations.routingShannonEntropy: H_a2a(z_t) = -sum_{a in A} P(a | z_t) * ln(P(a | z_t)) / ln(|A|)
equations.spectralLoopOscillationEnergy: L_spec(t) = (1 / (M - 1)) * sum_{m=2}^M ((1 - cos(v_m, v_{m-1})) / 2) * exp(-alpha * (t - t_m))

plane1PrescriptiveManifold.name: Plane 1 Continuous Golden Attractor Tube (What We HOPE & Plan)
plane1PrescriptiveManifold.stateSpace: Parameterized tube T*(tau) = (mu*(tau), Sigma*(tau)) in R^16 x R^{16x16} over continuous progress tau in [0, 1]

equations.splineAttractorMean: mu*(tau) = (1 - s) * mu_knot[i] + s * mu_knot[i+1] + 0.5 * s * (1 - s) * curvature_correction(tau)
equations.targetEmotionPotential: U*(tau) = -w_val * mu*(tau)[sentiment_valence] + w_aro * mu*(tau)[arousal_intensity] + w_eff * mu*(tau)[cognitive_effort_load]

plane2EmpiricalTrajectory.name: Plane 2 Continuous Trajectory Assimilation, Conformance Drift & Lyapunov Divergence (What DID Happen)
plane2EmpiricalTrajectory.stateSpace: Continuous stitched trajectory z(t) in R^16 assimilated from asynchronous event streams via exponential Kalman gain

equations.mahalanobisConformanceDrift: D_drift(t) = sqrt((z(t) - mu*(tau_t))^T * Sigma*(tau_t)^{-1} * (z(t) - mu*(tau_t))) / sqrt(16)
equations.wassersteinTubeTransportCost: W_2^2(P_emp, P_plan) = ||z(t) - mu*(tau_t)||_2^2 + trace(Sigma_emp(t) + Sigma*(tau_t) - 2 * (Sigma*(tau_t)^{1/2} * Sigma_emp(t) * Sigma*(tau_t)^{1/2})^{1/2})

stabilityRegimes.asymptoticallyConvergent: lambda_Lyap < -0.0015 (trajectory actively converging into the Golden Attractor tube)
stabilityRegimes.chaoticDivergent: lambda_Lyap > 0.0015 (trajectory diverging toward abandonment, ping-pong oscillation, or SLA collapse)

plane3ControlField.name: Plane 3 Continuous Hamiltonian / MPC Control Field (What IS Happening & SHOULD Happen)
plane3ControlField.stateSpace: Continuous control vector u*(t) in [0, 1]^6 over action basis [autonomous_progression, context_rehydration_impulse, a2a_specialist_blend, modality_fluid_shift, human_advocate_blend, outreach_damping_factor]

equations.hamiltonianCostFunctional: J(z(t), u(t)) = 0.5 * D_drift(t)^2 + c_ctx * (1 - F(t)) + c_loop * L_spec(t) + c_lyap * max(0, lambda_Lyap(t)) + 0.5 * u(t)^T * R * u(t)
equations.optimalSteeringGradient: u*(t) = softmax_or_project(-R^{-1} * B^T * grad_z J(z(t), mu*(tau_t)))
